name: Discovery
description: Defines declared artefact inventory, compatibility and relationship validation, separate from installation, readiness and authorisation.

relationships.rationale: Host generates inventory from explicitly selected trusted artefacts.
Discovery must distinguish refusal-only operation and trusted identity context.
Declarations and effective values remain source-owned.

unresolvedRelationships.description: Selected-host contract, package and extension graphs
unresolvedRelationships.reason: Actual dependencies and compatibility require implemented contract and host evidence; conceptual information exchanges do not prove them.
